title: Figure 20: SEM of a titanium brain electrode array made by electrodischarge machining
description: Scanning electron micrograph of a "bed of nails" electrode array: rows of thin, tall vertical needles rising from a base, with a "200µm" scale bar. The caption reads "Figure 20. Scanning Electron Micrograph of a Brain Electrode Array Manufactured From Titanium and Produced by a Process of Electrodischarge Machining" with a citation to "Electrical Discharge Machining and Chemical Etching." Text discusses deep brain stimulation and multichannel MEMS electrodes.
